scope: One-way M5.11 evaluation after validation-only selection; final results cannot alter selection or training
identity_policy: Because validation selected the unmodified base, one native base run is both base and selected evidence; duplicating inference would not create a second model comparison.
regression_policy: Reuse and hash-verify the complete M5.10 validation scores as regression evidence. Final pages are generated once only after this protocol and scorer are committed.
failure_policy: Retain every raw output, token ID, stop reason, diagnostic and export failure. Missing, malformed, truncated or failed output scores as empty; no repair, quality retry, case replacement or post-final selection change.
reporting: Report strict parser/export validity separately from exact recognition, Markdown CER/WER, picture IoU and source-pixel verification. Runtime and quality are independent.
